notes:
v0.3.3

Fixed: the fuel-save advisory could fire on every lap while the margin
stayed thin, with an audio alert each time, instead of once when it
actually became worth flagging.

Fixed: the fuel-save advisory's threshold demanded more spare fuel
than necessary, flagging races that finished with a comfortable
margin as tight - following the advice in that case could cost track
position with no real benefit.

Added: the notification log's font size can now be adjusted (A-/A+
buttons next to its header) and is remembered across launches.

Fixed: the website's checksum/VirusTotal display never rendered due
to a CORS restriction on GitHub's side - unrelated to this app
directly, but fixed as part of this release's infrastructure.
